answer_1.quote: ...we evaluate the instruction tuning quality of LLMs. We follow the current standard practice of utilizing GPT-4 as an unbiased reviewer... We also evaluate on the E2E benchmark, reporting BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR scores for generated utterances.
answer_1.outputs: generated natural language responses or utterances

answer_2.quote: ...we report three different metrics on the E2E task: (a) BLEU; (b) ROUGE-L; (c) METEOR. We rely on the HuggingFace Evaluate package for computing these metrics.

answer_3.quote: ...we follow the current standard practice of utilizing GPT-4 as an unbiased reviewer... GPT-4 is asked to write a review for both answers from the two methods, and assigns a quantitative score on a scale of 10 to each response.
